qb:conclusion.definition: The claim an argument tries to establish from its premises. It is not a new fact you may assume.
qb:conclusion.definition_ms: Dakwaan yang cuba diperoleh daripada premis; bukan fakta tambahan untuk diandaikan.

example.en: From the triangle premises, 'T has three sides' is the conclusion.

en.text: From the triangle premises, 'T has three sides' is the conclusion.

qb:converse.label: Converse
qb:converse.definition: Reverse if p then q to if q then p. Do not add NOT. The reversed rule need not be true.
qb:converse.definition_ms: Songsangkan jika p maka q menjadi jika q maka p; nilai kebenarannya mungkin berbeza.

qb:inverse.definition: Change if p then q to if NOT p then NOT q. Keep the original order. This need not match the original rule.
qb:inverse.definition_ms: Nafikan kedua-dua bahagian tanpa menukar turutan: jika bukan p maka bukan q.

qb:contrapositive.label: Contrapositive
qb:contrapositive.definition: Change if p then q to if NOT q then NOT p. Reverse the order and negate both. It is logically equivalent to the original.
qb:contrapositive.definition_ms: Tukar turutan dan nafikan kedua-dua bahagian: jika bukan q maka bukan p.

qb:logically-equivalent.label: Logically equivalent
qb:logically-equivalent.definition: The statements have the same truth value in every allowed truth-value case, not just in one example.
qb:logically-equivalent.definition_ms: Pernyataan mempunyai nilai kebenaran sama bagi setiap kes yang dibenarkan.

example.en: Matching just one row of a truth table is not enough to show equivalence.

en.text: The statements have the same truth value in every allowed truth-value case, not just in one example.

ms.text: Pernyataan mempunyai nilai kebenaran sama bagi setiap kes yang dibenarkan.

en.text: Matching just one row of a truth table is not enough to show equivalence.

qb:truth-table.label: Truth table
qb:truth-table.definition: A table listing all combinations of truth values so you can test a logical expression systematically.
qb:truth-table.definition_ms: Jadual semua gabungan nilai benar dan palsu untuk menyemak ungkapan logik.

example.en: For p and q, check TT, TF, FT, and FF.

en.text: A table listing all combinations of truth values so you can test a logical expression systematically.

qb:counterexample.label: Counterexample
qb:counterexample.definition: An allowed example that makes a general claim fail. For if p then q, it must satisfy p but fail q.
qb:counterexample.definition_ms: Contoh yang dibenarkan tetapi menggagalkan dakwaan; bagi implikasi, syarat benar tetapi kesimpulan palsu.

example.en: 'All multiples of 5 end in 5' fails at 30, which ends in 0.

, it must satisfy

but fail

en.text: 'All multiples of 5 end in 5' fails at 30, which ends in 0.

qb:argument.label: Argument
qb:argument.definition: Premises together with a conclusion that is claimed to follow from them.
qb:argument.definition_ms: Susunan premis bersama kesimpulan yang dikatakan mengikut premis tersebut.

example.en: Two starting claims followed by 'therefore ...' form an argument.

en.text: Premises together with a conclusion that is claimed to follow from them.

ms.text: Susunan premis bersama kesimpulan yang dikatakan mengikut premis tersebut.

en.text: Two starting claims followed by 'therefore
' form an argument.

qb:valid.label: Valid argument
qb:valid.definition: Whenever all premises are true, the conclusion must be true. Valid describes the reasoning pattern, not whether the actual premises are true.
qb:valid.definition_ms: Apabila semua premis benar, kesimpulan mesti benar; ini menilai bentuk penaakulan.

example.en: Try to find true premises with a false conclusion. If this is possible, the form is not valid.

en.text: Whenever all premises are true, the conclusion must be true. Valid describes the reasoning pattern, not whether the actual premises are true.

ms.text: Apabila semua premis benar, kesimpulan mesti benar; ini menilai bentuk penaakulan.

en.text: Try to find true premises with a false conclusion. If this is possible, the form is not valid.

qb:invalid.label: Invalid argument
qb:invalid.definition: It is possible for all premises to be true while the conclusion is false. The conclusion might happen to be true in some cases.
qb:invalid.definition_ms: Semua premis boleh benar tetapi kesimpulan palsu; kesimpulan tidak dijamin.

example.en: A possible case that keeps the premises true but breaks the conclusion shows invalidity.

en.text: It is possible for all premises to be true while the conclusion is false. The conclusion might happen to be true in some cases.

ms.text: Semua premis boleh benar tetapi kesimpulan palsu; kesimpulan tidak dijamin.

en.text: A possible case that keeps the premises true but breaks the conclusion shows invalidity.

qb:sound.label: Sound argument
qb:sound.definition: A valid argument whose premises are all actually true.
qb:sound.definition_ms: Hujah yang sah dan semua premisnya benar.

example.en: Check validity and the truth of each premise separately before calling an argument sound.

en.text: A valid argument whose premises are all actually true.

ms.text: Hujah yang sah dan semua premisnya benar.

en.text: Check validity and the truth of each premise separately before calling an argument sound.

qb:sufficient-condition.label: Sufficient condition
qb:sufficient-condition.definition: A condition that guarantees the result when it holds. It need not be the only way to obtain that result.
qb:sufficient-condition.definition_ms: Syarat yang cukup untuk menjamin hasil; tidak semestinya satu-satunya cara.

example.en: Being a square is sufficient for having four sides; other shapes can have four sides too.

en.text: A condition that guarantees the result when it holds. It need not be the only way to obtain that result.

ms.text: Syarat yang cukup untuk menjamin hasil; tidak semestinya satu-satunya cara.

en.text: Being a square is sufficient for having four sides; other shapes can have four sides too.

qb:modus-ponens.label: Modus ponens
qb:modus-ponens.definition: Use if p then q and the fact p to conclude q. Apply the rule after confirming its condition.
qb:modus-ponens.definition_ms: Daripada jika p maka q dan fakta p, simpulkan q.

example.en: If an item is a triangle, it has three sides. T is a triangle, so T has three sides.

qb:modus-tollens.label: Modus tollens
qb:modus-tollens.definition: Use if p then q and NOT q to conclude NOT p. The required result did not happen, so its condition cannot have held.
qb:modus-tollens.definition_ms: Daripada jika p maka q dan bukan q, simpulkan bukan p.

qb:affirming-consequent.definition: The invalid move from if p then q and q to p. A different condition might also produce q.
qb:affirming-consequent.definition_ms: Kesilapan menyimpulkan p daripada jika p maka q dan q; q boleh berlaku dengan cara lain.

qb:denying-antecedent.label: Denying the antecedent
qb:denying-antecedent.definition: The invalid move from if p then q and NOT p to NOT q. The result may still occur another way.
qb:denying-antecedent.definition_ms: Kesilapan menyimpulkan bukan q daripada jika p maka q dan bukan p.

qb:deductive.label: Deductive reasoning
qb:deductive.definition: Apply given rules or premises to reach a conclusion that must follow if those premises are true.
qb:deductive.definition_ms: Gunakan peraturan atau premis untuk memperoleh kesimpulan yang mesti mengikutnya jika premis benar.

example.en: Apply a rule about all triangles to one stated triangle.

en.text: Apply given rules or premises to reach a conclusion that must follow if those premises are true.

ms.text: Gunakan peraturan atau premis untuk memperoleh kesimpulan yang mesti mengikutnya jika premis benar.

en.text: Apply a rule about all triangles to one stated triangle.

qb:inductive.label: Inductive reasoning
qb:inductive.definition: Use observed examples to suggest a pattern or general claim. The suggestion is not guaranteed by the examples alone.
qb:inductive.definition_ms: Gunakan contoh yang diperhatikan untuk mencadangkan pola atau dakwaan umum; belum menjadi bukti pasti.

example.en: Several similar observations may suggest the next case, but do not force it.

en.text: Use observed examples to suggest a pattern or general claim. The suggestion is not guaranteed by the examples alone.

ms.text: Gunakan contoh yang diperhatikan untuk mencadangkan pola atau dakwaan umum; belum menjadi bukti pasti.

en.text: Several similar observations may suggest the next case, but do not force it.

qb:generalisation.label: Generalisation
qb:generalisation.definition: A claim extended from checked examples to a wider group or to cases not yet checked.
qb:generalisation.definition_ms: Dakwaan umum yang diperluas daripada contoh diperiksa kepada kes yang belum diperiksa.

example.en: Finding labels on several boxes may suggest that other boxes are labelled too.

en.text: A claim extended from checked examples to a wider group or to cases not yet checked.

ms.text: Dakwaan umum yang diperluas daripada contoh diperiksa kepada kes yang belum diperiksa.

en.text: Finding labels on several boxes may suggest that other boxes are labelled too.

qb:proof.label: Proof
qb:proof.definition: A logical explanation showing why a claim must hold for every case it covers, using accepted facts and valid reasoning.
qb:proof.definition_ms: Penerangan logik yang menunjukkan dakwaan mesti benar bagi semua kes dalam skopnya.

example.en: Checking a few examples alone is not a proof of a claim about all integers.

en.text: A logical explanation showing why a claim must hold for every case it covers, using accepted facts and valid reasoning.

ms.text: Penerangan logik yang menunjukkan dakwaan mesti benar bagi semua kes dalam skopnya.

en.text: Checking a few examples alone is not a proof of a claim about all integers.

qb:assumption.label: Assume / given
qb:assumption.definition: Treat the stated information as a starting fact for this question. Do not add facts the question did not supply.
qb:assumption.definition_ms: Terima maklumat yang dinyatakan sebagai fakta awal soalan; jangan tambah fakta sendiri.

example.en: If a question says 'assume the rule is true', reason from that rule for the question.

en.text: Treat the stated information as a starting fact for this question. Do not add facts the question did not supply.

ms.text: Terima maklumat yang dinyatakan sebagai fakta awal soalan; jangan tambah fakta sendiri.

en.text: If a question says 'assume the rule is true', reason from that rule for the question.

qb:sample.label: Sample
qb:sample.definition: The cases selected from a larger group for study. Repeating one case does not make it many different cases.
qb:sample.definition_ms: Sebahagian kes yang dipilih daripada kumpulan lebih besar untuk dikaji.

example.en: Rooms selected for checking are a sample of the dungeon's rooms.

en.text: The cases selected from a larger group for study. Repeating one case does not make it many different cases.

ms.text: Sebahagian kes yang dipilih daripada kumpulan lebih besar untuk dikaji.

en.text: Rooms selected for checking are a sample of the dungeon's rooms.

qb:random-sample.label: Random sample
qb:random-sample.definition: A sample selected by a chance-based method rather than by choosing only preferred cases. Good coverage of the target group still matters.
qb:random-sample.definition_ms: Sampel yang dipilih melalui kaedah rawak, bukan memilih kes yang disukai sahaja.

example.en: Select room IDs by a random method instead of choosing rooms known to fit a claim.

en.text: A sample selected by a chance-based method rather than by choosing only preferred cases. Good coverage of the target group still matters.

ms.text: Sampel yang dipilih melalui kaedah rawak, bukan memilih kes yang disukai sahaja.

en.text: Select room IDs by a random method instead of choosing rooms known to fit a claim.

qb:population.label: Population / target group
qb:population.definition: The whole group that the study or claim is about.
qb:population.definition_ms: Keseluruhan kumpulan yang menjadi sasaran kajian atau dakwaan.

example.en: For a claim about every room, all relevant rooms form the population.

en.text: The whole group that the study or claim is about.

ms.text: Keseluruhan kumpulan yang menjadi sasaran kajian atau dakwaan.

en.text: For a claim about every room, all relevant rooms form the population.

qb:sample-size.label: Sample size
qb:sample-size.definition: The number of different cases checked. More cases can help, but do not remove bias by themselves.
qb:sample-size.definition_ms: Bilangan kes berbeza yang diperiksa; sampel besar masih boleh berat sebelah.

example.en: Checking 25 different rooms gives more cases than checking one room 25 times.

en.text: The number of different cases checked. More cases can help, but do not remove bias by themselves.

ms.text: Bilangan kes berbeza yang diperiksa; sampel besar masih boleh berat sebelah.

en.text: Checking 25 different rooms gives more cases than checking one room 25 times.

qb:selection-bias.label: Selection bias
qb:selection-bias.definition: A selection method that systematically favours some cases, so the sample may misrepresent the target group.
qb:selection-bias.definition_ms: Pemilihan yang cenderung kepada kes tertentu sehingga sampel mungkin tidak mewakili kumpulan sasaran.

example.en: Checking only rooms already known to contain treasure biases a claim about all rooms.

en.text: A selection method that systematically favours some cases, so the sample may misrepresent the target group.

ms.text: Pemilihan yang cenderung kepada kes tertentu sehingga sampel mungkin tidak mewakili kumpulan sasaran.

en.text: Checking only rooms already known to contain treasure biases a claim about all rooms.

qb:observation.label: Observation
qb:observation.definition: Something actually checked or recorded, rather than guessed about an untested case.
qb:observation.definition_ms: Perkara yang benar-benar diperiksa atau direkodkan.

example.en: 'The visited room contained a chest' records an observation.

en.text: Something actually checked or recorded, rather than guessed about an untested case.

ms.text: Perkara yang benar-benar diperiksa atau direkodkan.

en.text: 'The visited room contained a chest' records an observation.

qb:prediction.label: Prediction
qb:prediction.definition: A claim about a result not yet checked. A pattern may support it without proving it.
qb:prediction.definition_ms: Jangkaan terhadap keputusan yang belum diperiksa; pola boleh menyokongnya tetapi belum membuktikannya.

example.en: Predicting an unvisited room's contents goes beyond what was observed.

en.text: A claim about a result not yet checked. A pattern may support it without proving it.

ms.text: Jangkaan terhadap keputusan yang belum diperiksa; pola boleh menyokongnya tetapi belum membuktikannya.

en.text: Predicting an unvisited room's contents goes beyond what was observed.

qb:sequence.label: Sequence / term
qb:sequence.definition: A sequence is a list in order. Each entry is a term. A shown pattern suggests a continuation unless a complete rule is supplied.
qb:sequence.definition_ms: Jujukan ialah senarai mengikut turutan; setiap nombor ialah sebutan.

example.en: In 5, 10, 15, the second term is 10.

en.text: A sequence is a list in order. Each entry is a term. A shown pattern suggests a continuation unless a complete rule is supplied.

ms.text: Jujukan ialah senarai mengikut turutan; setiap nombor ialah sebutan.

en.text: In 5, 10, 15, the second term is 10.

qb:pattern.label: Pattern
qb:pattern.definition: A noticed regularity in the shown cases. More than one rule can sometimes fit a short list.
qb:pattern.definition_ms: Aturan yang diperhatikan dalam contoh; senarai pendek boleh sepadan dengan lebih daripada satu aturan.

example.en: A constant increase can suggest how to continue a number list.

en.text: A noticed regularity in the shown cases. More than one rule can sometimes fit a short list.

ms.text: Aturan yang diperhatikan dalam contoh; senarai pendek boleh sepadan dengan lebih daripada satu aturan.

en.text: A constant increase can suggest how to continue a number list.

qb:teaching-pool.label: Teaching pool
qb:teaching-pool.definition: A fixed collection supplied for this learning question. It is not automatically the player's live deck or an actual drop rate.
qb:teaching-pool.definition_ms: Kumpulan contoh tetap dalam soalan; tidak semestinya deck atau kadar drop sebenar pemain.

example.en: Use only the cards and counts listed in the question.

en.text: A fixed collection supplied for this learning question. It is not automatically the player's live deck or an actual drop rate.

ms.text: Kumpulan contoh tetap dalam soalan; tidak semestinya deck atau kadar drop sebenar pemain.

en.text: Use only the cards and counts listed in the question.

qb:draw.label: Draw / select
qb:draw.definition: Take or choose an item from the stated pool. Check whether it is returned before the next draw.
qb:draw.definition_ms: Ambil atau pilih item daripada kumpulan; semak sama ada item dimasukkan semula.

example.en: Two draws means taking an item twice under the stated return rule.

en.text: Take or choose an item from the stated pool. Check whether it is returned before the next draw.

ms.text: Ambil atau pilih item daripada kumpulan; semak sama ada item dimasukkan semula.

en.text: Two draws means taking an item twice under the stated return rule.

qb:unique-id.label: Distinct / unique card ID
qb:unique-id.definition: Different IDs represent different physical items, even if the items share a colour or category.
qb:unique-id.definition_ms: ID berbeza mewakili item berlainan walaupun warna atau kategorinya sama.

example.en: Cards r7 and r8 are two different cards even if both are red.

en.text: Different IDs represent different physical items, even if the items share a colour or category.

ms.text: ID berbeza mewakili item berlainan walaupun warna atau kategorinya sama.

en.text: Cards r7 and r8 are two different cards even if both are red.

qb:category.label: Category
qb:category.definition: A group label for an item. If a question says exactly one category, the categories cannot overlap for that item.
qb:category.definition_ms: Label kumpulan item; jika soalan menetapkan satu kategori sahaja, kategori itu tidak bertindih bagi item tersebut.

example.en: Use the category rule stated in the question rather than adding another category.

en.text: A group label for an item. If a question says exactly one category, the categories cannot overlap for that item.

ms.text: Label kumpulan item; jika soalan menetapkan satu kategori sahaja, kategori itu tidak bertindih bagi item tersebut.

en.text: Use the category rule stated in the question rather than adding another category.

qb:energy-cost.label: Energy / cost
qb:energy-cost.definition: Energy is a game resource. A card's Energy cost is how much of that resource is needed to play it.
qb:energy-cost.definition_ms: Energy ialah sumber game; kos kad ialah jumlah Energy untuk memainkannya.

example.en: A cost-3 card requires 3 Energy under the stated card rule.

en.text: Energy is a game resource. A card's Energy cost is how much of that resource is needed to play it.

ms.text: Energy ialah sumber game; kos kad ialah jumlah Energy untuk memainkannya.

en.text: A cost-3 card requires 3 Energy under the stated card rule.

qb:upgraded.label: Upgraded
qb:upgraded.definition: An item marked as improved. For a set question, use only the listed IDs in the upgraded group.
qb:upgraded.definition_ms: Item yang ditandakan telah ditambah baik; bagi soalan set, ikut senarai ID yang diberi.

example.en: An upgraded label does not let you assume any unlisted card is in the upgraded set.

en.text: An item marked as improved. For a set question, use only the listed IDs in the upgraded group.

ms.text: Item yang ditandakan telah ditambah baik; bagi soalan set, ikut senarai ID yang diberi.

en.text: An upgraded label does not let you assume any unlisted card is in the upgraded set.
